*SEEKING A FOSTER-TO-ADOPT*

Looking to bring a slice of pure serenity into your life? 🌊✨

✈️ Brooke is arriving via flight chaperone in the near future to LaGuardia Airport. She is seeking a person/family to welcome her upon her arrival!

By applying for Brooke, you’ll participate in our foster / foster-to-adopt program! Brooke is a gorgeous, young (2-year-old, 13-pound) ebony-coated Pug mix making her way from San Diego, California to the East Coast, following right in the footsteps of her stellar mama, Nova.

While we’re still getting to know this gentle girl, one thing is clear—she brings a calming, tranquil energy paired with that irresistible, sweet face. The only catch: Brooke will need a canine companion at home. She was incredibly bonded to her mama, so we imagine a confident canine companion will help to ease her transition. Brooke is ready to start her next chapter and bring a beautiful sense of peace and joy to her future family.

If you’re looking for a gentle, affectionate companion to be your everyday slice of serenity, Brooke may be your girl.

Brooke will likely need some level of house / leash / crate training. She is known to be dog friendly. No additional photos or information are available at this time.

Vaccinated for rabies, DHPP, and bordetella, heartworm negative, microchipped and spayed. Current on flea, tick, and heartworm prevention.

To apply for Brooke, visit our website (www.waggytailrescue.org) for an adoption application. It is important to fill out an application as soon as possible for consideration, and we require a complete application for you to meet an animal. We are currently unable to respond to general email inquiries as an all-volunteer run rescue. If the dog is on our website, they are still available.

Waggytail Rescue CANNOT guarantee the exact age of any adoptable dog, or final size of any of our adoptable puppies. We rely on the information provided to us by veterinarians, shelters, owner surrenders and other circumstances bringing the dog into our rescue.

Adoptions: adopt@waggytailrescue.org
